Commentary.Commentary: Okay! The Malinga chapter is done in ODIs but what about this series? It has just begun! Will Bangladesh be able to bounce back and level the series? Will Sri Lanka be able to move on from the Slinga absence? Only time will tell. Join us on Sunday, 28th July, 2019 at 2.30 pm local (0900 GMT) for all the action from the second ODI. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

The fireworks go off and 'Thank you, Mali!' signboards go up in the stands. Boy, he will be missed. Those yorkers. Fast and furious. Then some with terrific change in pace, taking ever so long to come. But deadly accurate. Thank you, Lasith Malinga, for teaching us that it is not always archers who can be accurate. Thank you, for teaching us that it is not only bowlers with conventional action who can survive in this sport. A terrific competitor, but a humble human being. Wishing you a great future in whatever you do next, though there is plenty of T20 cricket still to come.

A long, emotional speech comes to an end at last. Another presentation. This time from Malinga, as he gives a token of appreciation to former Lankan fast bowling coach, Champaka Ramanayake. A wonderful gesture.
Lasith Malinga is now given a special token, with his family being invited as well. Time for the farewell speech. He chooses to do so in Sinhalese and the crowd goes wild.

Victorious Sri Lankan captain, Dimuth Karunaratne, says that all the team members supported him throughout the World Cup. Reckons that the Lankans were on the right path even during the mega tournament but they just needed some time to enhance. Believes that tournament opened up their plans to bat well consistently and that was witnessed in this game. On Malinga's final game, Karunaratne says that he egged his boys on to give their 200 percent for the legend. Admits that the Lankans need to find a couple of bowlers as Malinga's replacement but is happy with the performance of Lahiru Kumara. On the legend finally, Dimuth says that Malinga has been a great servant of Sri Lankan cricket, always stepping up when the captain needed him to and says that he will be missed, though he will be around in the T20Is.

Bangladesh captain, Tamim Iqbal, manages to put in a smile. Admits that he has been struggling with the bat over the last few weeks and needs to start performing. Praises his bowlers for coming back strongly towards the end as at one stage, they looked to be chasing 350. But is disappointed over the no-show with the bat. On missing the injured key players, Tamim says that he is happy with the squad of 15 that he has and it is just a matter of realizing one's role. Feels that there are still two more matches to go and if he starts scoring and everyone else chips in, things will change.

KUSAL PERERA HAS BEEN NAMED THE MAN OF THE MATCH for his spectacular 111. First, he is asked as to how is he feeling since he did not take part in the second innings. Kusal says that it was a slight back niggle and he is feeling better now. On his batting innings, Perera says that the number 3 role suits him more and he played his shots, taking a calculated risk every now and then as Bangladesh were bowling well. On Lasith Malinga, Perera says that he is a legend, always helping and advising youngsters.

Take aside Lasith Malinga, there were quite a few positives for Sri Lanka in this game. But they need more of these and with some consistency. Where were these during the World Cup? Do they have the batsmen to step up when needed? Do they have seamers in store for the future? Sunday and Wednesday will give us a better indication. Time for the presentation...

'Mali! Mali! Mali!' were the chants continuously as soon as the Lankans took the field in the second innings. And he did not disappoint. He knocked Tamim Iqbal's timber over and then had Soumya Sarkar dismissed in identical fashion. At 39/4, the game looked done and dusted and the 111-run stand between Mushfiqur Rahim and Sabbir Rahman just delayed the inevitable. Nuwan Pradeep did a decent job with 3 scalps and fittingly in the end, it was Slinga who closed the game, with his third scalp.

Coming to the game, it was totally Sri Lanka. They put their best foot forward by winning the toss and though they lost Avishka Fernando early, Kusal Perera and skipper Dimuth Karunaratne took the game away with a 97-run stand. Perera's 111 knocked the wind out of Bangladesh's sails and even though they did come back towards the end, 314/8 was a big enough total on the board.

Lasith Malinga says that he has played the last 15 years for Sri Lanka and believes that it is time for the new generation to take over for the 2023 World Cup. Thanks the crowd for its continuous support. Is happy with the win. On his effort throughout his career, Malinga says that his captain always expected him to take a wicket and he tried his best. On the Lankan future, Lasith says that there are a couple of Lankan youngsters in the ranks and they should be looked after.

The legend is taking a walk around the park with one of the greatest Sri Lankan fans, if not the greatest, Percy, who is happy to follow him like a bodyguard. The Lankan star is taking a victory march, with Percy happily waving the Lankan flag around. He is now halted in his tracks, after completing the march, for a chat, by Roshan Abeysinghe.

Numbers. That is what the game is made up of. 35. Malinga's age. Just a number. 91. The victory margin for Sri Lanka tonight. Again, just another number. But the numbers that matter - 226 ODIs and 338 wickets. Goes past Anil Kumble and moves to number 9 in the list of leading wicket-takers in ODIs. 536 international wickets. Take a bow, Separamadu Lasith Malinga.

OUT! Caught! Lasith Malinga fittingly takes the final wicket of the match! He stands there with his arms aloft in the air and the Lankan supporters are on their feet, to applaud their favourite son. A length ball outside off, slightly slower, Mustafizur backs away and aims to hit this over mid off. But he only skies it high in the air and it is a pressure catch for Thisara Perera. Yes, pressure catch because it could be the final time he would be involved in helping Mali take a wicket. He runs back from short extra cover, keeps his eyes on the ball and takes it over his head. SRI LANKA WIN BY 91 RUNS!

Almost! A slower ball outside off, Rubel backs away, aiming to steer it towards third man but is defeated by the lack of pace. Somehow, the ball hits the bat and deflects behind point. A single taken.
A yorker outside off, squeezed straight to point.
FOUR! That has stunned the crowd into silence. A length ball, around middle, Rubel swings it cleanly over mid-wicket, a bounce and into the fence!
Last 6 balls (technically) of Malinga's ODI career. Could be last 5, 4, 3, 2 or 1 ball also...

FOUR! Edgy but will do for Bangladesh. Pradeep bowls it on the off side on a good length, Rahman tries to drive it towards cover but gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies between 3rd slip and gully and races away towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Yorker this time by Pradeep, the Fizz heaves it over point. The fielders cut it off before it reaches the boundary and the batters take two.
Bouncer by Pradeep, at full pace on middle and leg. Rahman somehow ducks and gets out of the way of the ball.
Backs away to the leg side and Pradeep fires it wide outside off. The Fizz lets it go.

FOUR! Off the edge this time! Gosh - how did the bat come down in time? A full and fast ball, in line of the stumps, Mustafizur looks to protect his left leg, getting it out of the way but manages to get his bat down in time. The ball goes off the outside edge, towards second slip, but wide of the diving Dhananjaya de Silva, to the third man fence.
FOUR! Full ball just outside off, Rahman makes room for himself and plays it over the covers for a boundary.
Powerplay 3 time. 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle, if Karunaratne wants.
Slower yorker by Malinga, Hossain jams it out.
Good length ball outside off, Rubel slashes at it but finds the mid off fielder.
Slower ball on middle, Rahman plays with the full face of the bat with soft hands and quickly  scampers through the other end for a single.
Play and a miss! Mustafizur is just looking to smash it out of the park. He heaves at the ball and misses.
Almost a yorker outside off, Rahman tries to heave it over mid-wicket but bottom edges it towards mid-wicket.
Slower ball on a good length just outside off, Rahman plays inside the line of the delivery.

Short in length and outside off, Rahman throws his bat at it and slaps it over point. Avishka chases it down near the fence, in fact the ball stopped itself, and the fielder pulls it back with a slide. The batsmen take three. 4 runs and two wickets in the over and Sri Lanka will be smelling victory!
Beaten again! On a good length and close to off, Mustafizur tries to push inside the line and misses.
Play and a miss! Pradeep switches to 'round the wicket and delivers it on a length outside off. Rahman tries playing the line but it nips away to beat the outside edge.
Mustafizur Rahman is the last batsman.

OUT! Stumps are disturbed, number 9 goes down for Bangladesh. Good length ball on the perfect line for Pradeep, the off pole line. The ball pitches and just slightly nips away from the line of the bat. It goes past the outside edge and clips the top of off stump. The Lankans are on the brink of victory here.
Pitches it up and outside off, Rubel drives it through covers and gets a run to open his account.
Rubel Hossain is the new batsman.

OUT! Pradeep strikes straightaway and eliminates Bangladesh's last hope. He delivers a shortish length ball in the line of the stumps, Rahim shuffles across the stumps to paddle it around the corner but fails to get the desired connection. It comes off the bottom edge and settles into the safe gloves of Kusal Mendis. Good fight from Rahim is over, he walks back dejected.
Nuwan Pradeep returns into the attack.
Bouncer by Malinga, Rahim tries to pull this one but only gets a top edge to it. The ball floats towards the fine leg region and Rahim keeps the strike by taking a single.
Full on the pads of Mushfiqur, he pushes it towards mid on.
Wide! Again down the leg side by Malinga, this time Rahim goes for it but he misses. The umpire has wided this one too.
Wide! Down the leg side by Malinga, Rahim lets it be.

Direct hit and Islam was a goner. Malinga bowls a yorker on the off pole and Rahim jams it towards cover. Islam sets off for a run but is sent back by Mushfiqur. Thisara goes for a direct hit towards the non-striker's end but luckily for Islam, he misses.
Good length ball on off, Rahim defends it off the back foot.
Leg bye. Full ball again outside leg, it hits the pad of Islam and the ball rolls towards square leg. The batters cross and take a run.
Lasith Malinga is into the attack again. 7-2-28-2, so far.
Full on the pads of Rahim, he glances it towards fine leg for a single.
Flatter ball on leg, Rahim guides it towards square leg and keeps the strike. 10-0-49-2, job well done by the part-timer!
Islam guides this one towards square leg and takes a single.
Shafiul again comes on the front foot and plays it towards mid-wicket.
Islam prods forward and blocks this leg sided ball out.
On the pads this time, Rahim tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Flatter on off, Rahim looks to cut but misses.
Length ball on off, Mushfiqur gets onto the back foot and punches it towards cover point for one.
Short ball outside off now, this time Islam gets an edge on it and it flies over third slip for a single.
Similar length, Islam misses again. Kumara keeping him on strike and doing well for Sri Lanka here.
Short one again. Islam again tries to play at it but misses. He looks out of sorts here.
Wide! Another bouncer by Kumara but this time it is too high. Islam tries to play at it but misses and the ball carries through to the keeper.
Bouncer following the yorker. Islam tries to get bat on ball but misses. The Lankans appeal but it is dismissed by the umpire.
Yorker to begin with by Kumara. Shafiul digs it out towards point.
Shafiul Islam walks in now as Sri Lanka get into the Bangladeshi bowlers.

OUT! Caught behind! Dhananjaya has his second. This match looks to be hurrying to a close now. Landed outside off, Mehedi looks to guide it towards third man but only feathers it into the gloves of Kusal Mendis who collects it and straightaway leaps in celebration. The umpire has his finger raised this time. Useful from DdS - 9-0-46-2.

Appeal for LBW, turned down! That looked plumb. Full and around middle, Mehedi looks to flick after getting across but misses and is hit flush on the pads. The Lankans appeal long and hard but the umpire is unmoved.
Comes down the track and works it over short mid-wicket for one.
Pitched outside leg, Mushfiqur looks to play the reverse sweep but is hit on the glove.
Punches this through mid on, past the diving short mid-wicket fielder for a run.
Full on middle, Rahim comes down the track and whips it towards long on for a single.
Landed outside off, played behind point for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Outside off, punched through cover for a single.
Outside off, Mehidy ducks.
Mehedi Hasan walks in next. Slip comes in straightaway.

OUT! Run out! Oh my... What have the Bangladeshi batsmen done here? Kumara bowls this ball short and wide outside leg. Mosaddek tries to pull this one but misses and the ball goes high to Kusal Mendis. He leaps up and stops it from going behind him but the batters think it has gone away from the keeper. Mosaddek responds to Rahim's call and sets off for a run. Suddenly, Rahim sends Mosaddek back as keeper Kusal Mendis has collected the ball. He takes off his gloves, sees that he has three stumps to aim at and goes for the direct hit at the keeper's end and hits. Mosaddek is way short and has to depart. The budding partnership is broken and Rahim looks to be running out of partners. Just for the record, it was given as a wide as well.
Similar line and length, this time Rahim guides it down to third man for one.
Length ball on off, Mosaddek guides down to third man for a single
Kumara is back into the attack now.
On middle and off, Rahim looks to flick but the ball goes off the leading edge back to the bowler. Does not carry.
On middle and leg again, worked through mid-wicket for one more.
On middle and leg, flicked away for a run.
WIDE. Fired down the leg side, left alone.
Outside off, tapped towards point for a single.
On middle, pushed towards long on. Short mid-wicket intercepts.
Full and around middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Short ball bowled by Malinga, Mosaddek plays the pull shot towards square leg and takes a single.

Stifled appeal by the Lankans, but the umpire turns it down. The ball is full and on middle and leg, Rahim tries to flick but misses. The ball hits the pads of Rahim and it rolls towards fine leg as the batters cross for a single.
FOUR! Bad ball by Malinga, on the pads of Mushfiqur and he just helps it on his way to the fine leg fence.
Short of a length ball outside off, Rahim cuts it towards point
Full ball this time by Malinga, Rahim drives this one towards mid-wicket.
2 Wides! Wayward ball by Malinga. Way down the leg side. Hossain lets it go through to the keeper. He dives to his left and does well to save some runs here for his side.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
On middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, played through point for a run.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
On middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single. 36th ODI fifty for Rahim! He has batted sensibly so far but will need to stay till the end if Bangladesh have to stay in the hunt.

Excellent stop in the deep. Landed around middle, Rahim gets down and pulls it through mid-wicket. Avishka Fernando gives a good chase in the deep, runs to his right, dives and flicks it towards substitute Wanindu Hasaranga who comes running to his left from fine leg. A couple taken.

DRINKS! The Tigers have pulled it back in this phase and the run chase is on. However, they have lost the important wicket of Sabbir Rahman who was well set and looking to go big. Mushfiqur and Mosaddek will be looking to take this chase as deep as they possibly can. Sri Lanka on the other hand will be looking to break this partnership and get into the tail-enders.
FOUR! Fine shot. A short ball, around middle, Mosaddek pulls it through mid-wicket. Lahiru Thirimanne dives to his right in the deep but in vain.
WIDE. A short ball, down the leg side, MH looks to pull but misses. Another appeal for a caught behind but it is turned down. Seemed to be hitting the glove as per the replays...
Outside off, a play and a miss.
Full and around middle, pushed towards short mid-wicket.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Connects with the pull this time, through square leg and gets a run.
WIDE. This is signalled a wide. A short ball, down the leg side, Mosaddek looks to pull but misses.

Down the leg side, is that a catch? Not a wide either. Bizarre. Malinga bowls his first ball full and down the leg side. Mossadek looks to flick but misses. The Lankans thought that Hossain had edged it. Hossain is amused how it has not been wided. The ball has carried through to the keeper who also appeals loudly. Everyone is puzzled by this decision. It seems like the umpire is of the opinion that it clipped the pads of the batter.
Dimuth Karunaratne has brought the stadium alive. By bringing Lasith Malinga back into the attack. 5-2-12-2 so far.
Pushes this through mid on for a run. 4 runs and a wicket from the over, Dhananjaya's figures read 6-0-34-1.
On middle, tucked towards square leg. Thisara Perera gets across quickly from short mid-wicket and fires a direct hit at the bowler's end as the batsmen take a single. Smiles all around. No danger.
On middle and leg, this is flicked towards short fine leg.
Pushes this through mid on for a run.
Mosaddek Hossain walks in at number 7, replacing Sabbir.

OUT! Caught! For the second time in the game, Nelson has struck. In the first innings, it was Kusal Perera who was dismissed for 111. Here, it is the 111-run stand which has been broken. Tossed up on middle, Sabbir comes down the track and looks to flick it over the leg side. He does not connect it well enough and this ground is not that small either. Simple catch for Lahiru Kumara at deep mid-wicket. Rahman hits himself with his bat as he walks off. Could not quite finish the job. Bangladesh in a spot of bother again. 165 more needed from 130 balls.
Comes down the track, takes it on the full and bunts it towards long on for a single.

Good fielding by Pradeep. He bowls this one fullish and on off, Rahman drives it straight towards the bowler. Pradeep gets down diving to his left in his followthrough and holds onto it. Sri Lanka need more of this and have to stop the flow of runs here.
On the leg side, Rahim plays this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Mushfiqur cuts it towards backward point for a couple.
Full toss on off pole, it goes towards mid on. The batsmen cross and take a single.
Good length ball, hits on the pads of Sabbir. It goes back to the bowler.
Length ball just outside off, he guides it towards third man for a single.
Outside off, eased towards cover for one.
Around off, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and around middle, swept through square leg for a run.
On middle, flicked through square leg for a couple.
Outside off, punched towards long on but short mid-wicket swiftly gets across to his left and slides to stop the ball. Sabbir is sent back, as he was looking for the single.
Around leg, Sabbir looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Short ball bowled by Pradeep, Rahman pulls it but gets a top edge on it. The ball falls safely at backward square leg. The batters cross for a single.
Length ball on the off side, Rahim punches it off the back foot through point.
Good lenghth ball on the off side, Rahman drives this one through the covers.

Uppish but safe! Short of a length on off, Rahman tries to pull this one for a boundary but manages to get just the top edge on it. It flies over the head of the fielder at short mid-wicket and the fielders take a couple of runs.
Short of a length ball, Rahman pulls this towards short mid-wicket. No runs taken.
On a length around off, coming in, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Mushfiqur flicks this one off his pads for a single.
Rahim prods forward to defend this with the full face of the bat.
Rahim plays this flat one towards short fine leg.
Again tossed on leg, driven towards mid on for one.
On the hips of Rahim, he plays it towards square leg and takes a single.
Tossed up on leg, drives it towards long on for one.
50 for Rahman off just 42 balls. 6th ODI fifty for him. Short of a length this time on off, Rahman pulls this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full ball again on the pads, this time Rahim takes a single towards mid on.
Full ball on the legs of Rahman, he drives it towards mid on and takes a single.
Bouncer and left alone. Thisara hits the deck hard on the off pole line, Rahman lets it carry through to the keeper.
Short and on off, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Cheeky! Great shot here by Mushfiqur. Perera bowls it on a good length, Rahim gets on one knee and paddles the ball right over the head of the keeper. The ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Short ball on middle, Rahman defends this off the back foot.
Tossed up on off pole, Rahim gets on the front foot and plays it to point for a single.
Flatter one on the pads, Rahim tucks it through square leg for a couple of runs.
Goes on the back foot and punches it towards mid on for a run. Smart batting.
FOUR! Sabbir is playing a little gem here! A flighted full ball on middle and leg, Rahman kneels and nails his sweeps shot behind square leg for a boundary. Nicely placed. He is nearing his fifty.
The batsman works it down the leg side. Two runs added to the total.
Uppish but falls short. The ball is bowled short and Sabbir pulls this one but gets a top edge on it. It flies towards the deep square leg fielder but falls short. The batsman take one.
Length ball outside off, Mushfiqur opens the face of the and guides the ball towards third man for a single.
Length ball just outside off, defended off the back foot by MR.
Mushfiqur plays this full ball towards covers off the front foot.
Shortish ball on off, he pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Full ball outside off, he drives it towards extra cover. The batters take two runs.
Thisara Perera is back on! 4-0-23-0, his figures so far.
Once again it is on the pads, Rahman flicks it away with no fuss towards mid-wicket for a single. He will keep the strike.
On the pads, SR flicks it to the on side for a single.
Tossed up on off, Sabbir defends it off the front foot.
On the pads, Mushfiqur glances it down the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Brilliantly executed by Mushfiqur. Floated on off, Mushfiqur gets down on one knee and reverse sweeps it through backward point for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, Mushfiqur turns it to the leg side but straight to backward square leg.
Rahman goes onto the back foot and defends it by getting right in the line of the delivery.
Hit on the pads, a stifled appeal by the Lankans. It seems like it is going down the leg side and the replays confirm it.
FOUR! Hammered away! Back of a length ball around off, Sabbir stands tall and pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary. The fielder at deep square leg had no chance cleaning that.
Full length ball on the legs of Rahman, he plays it towards mid-wicket and takes two.
NHits the wickets... but at the non-strikers end! Hit straight down the ground but too straight. The bowler tries to get a hand to it but is not able to.
Short ball wide outside off, Sabbir lets it through to the keeper.
Floated around off, Sabbir strokes it towards cover and keeps the strike. 6 runs off Dhananjaya's first over.
On middle and leg, MR flicks it to the on side and rotates the strike.
WIDE! De Silva misses his line and bowls this down the leg side. Mushfiqur looks to sweep but misses. Wided by the umpire.
Flighted on leg, Sabbir sweeps it behind square for a single.
On the pads, Rahim flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter on off, Mushfiqur punches it to cover.
Tossed up around off, Sabbir turns it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Dhananjaya de Silva is introduced into the attack.
Good length ball outside off, Sabbir punches it towards cover for a single. That brings up the 50-run stand between the two.
Full on leg, Mushfiqur flicks it to square leg and gets a single.

FOUR! Good shot by Rahim. Boundary after a long time for Bangladesh. The ball is full and on the pads of Rahim, he flicks it towards the empty deep mid-wicket region. The fielder gives it a chase, puts in the dive but falls just short as the ball wins the race.
On the hips of Mushfiqur, he flicks it towards deep square leg and takes a single.
Short of a length just outside off, Rahim guides it towards point.
Short ball on middle pole by Kumara, rahim ducks and lets it go to the keeper.
Short ball on chest height, Rahim pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Substitute Isuru Udana picks up the ball as the batters cross for a single.
Length ball on off, Rahim plays it towards cover point off the back foot.
Good length ball on off, Rahim pushes it towards cover.
Once again it is a back of a length ball around off, Sabbir pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Sabbir is going after Perera here. Good length ball outside off, Sabbir pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Oh! Inside edge to the rescue. Full ball around off, it comes back in. Sabbir looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Kumara bowls a well directed bouncer on middle, Rahim does well to evade it.

Good shot. Just a glance off the pads by Rahman. He leans on his front foot and flicks it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder gives it a chase and stops it from reaching the fence. The batters take three runs.
Length ball on the hips of Rahim, he dabs it towards the leg side and takes a run.
Full length ball on the pads, Rahim plays it towards mid on.
Shortish ball on the off side, Rahman pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Length ball on the off pole line, Rahim plays it with soft hands on the leg side and takes a single.

FOUR! Back to back boundaries to end the over. This is on a length around off, Sabbir smashes it off the back foot through covers for a boundary. Good over for Bangladesh. 14 runs off it. Bangladesh need these two to carry on.
FOUR! Creamed through covers. Full around off, Sabbir picks the length early and drives it on the up through covers for a boundary.
WIDE! Perera misses his line and bowls it down the leg side. It has been wided by the umpire.
On the off pole, Sabbir drives it towards cover. The fielder there dives to his left and stops a certain boundary.
FOUR! Of the top edge. Bouncer around off, Sabbir goes for the pull but gets a top edge on it which flies over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Comes down the track and hits it hard towards mid off. Rahim calls for a quick single, Sabbir responds. Karunaratne has a shy at the keeper's end but misses.
Good length ball outside off. It comes back in after hitting the deck. Mushfiqur looks to defend but misses and the ball hits him high on the knee roll.
Full toss ball on middle and leg, Rahman punches it towards the mid on fielder. A bad over by Kumara comes to an end. 14 off it. Bangladesh are 55/4 at the end of 14 overs.
Rahman gets in line of the delivery and punches this ball of the back foot.

5 Wides! Terrible bowling here by Kumara. Another bouncer on leg which goes way over the head of both the batter and the keeper. Rahman ducks and the keeper tries to leap and stop the ball from going past him but to no avail. It goes into the fence and 5 wides given.
Length ball again outside off. Rahman gets onto the back foot and punches it back towards the bowler.
Yorker on off pole. Rahman jams it out towards mid off.
Length ball on off and defended off the back foot by Rahman.
FOUR! Cut and cut hard by Rahman. 9 runs off the first ball. The ball is short and wide outside off, there to be hit. Rahman slashes at it and the ball races to the deep point fence.
5 Wides! Bad bowling by Lahiru here. Way over the head of the batsman. He ducks under it and lets it go. It flies over the head of the keeper as well and races to the fence.

DRINKS BREAK. Sadly, nothing going right for Bangladesh. They were pummeled when bowling and now, with the bat, they are being pummeled by the Lankans with the ball. This is quickly going down as a one-sided drubbing, unless we get some fight.
Good length ball on off, Rahim pushes it back to the bowler. End of a good over by Perera. Sri Lanka are on top of the Tigers.

Close one this! Rahim survives. Good delivery by Perera, he bowls it on the off pole line and gets it to nip away from Rahim. He plays at it, but just inside the line of the ball. Luckily for him, there was no bat or glove involved in this.
Good length ball on the middle pole, Rahman shuffles across the stumps and plays it towards mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, Sabbir flashes his blade without moving his feet and misses.
Outside off, Sabbir takes his bat away from the line.
Around off, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Rahman gets behind the line of the ball and defends it back to the bowler.
Sabbir Rahman is the new man in. Can he forge some sort of a partnership with Rahim?

OUT! CAUGHT! Bad shot selection by Mahmudullah! Kumara bowls a bouncer on the off pole line, Mahmudullah tries the upper cut even though a fielder is placed at deep third man. It is a simple catch as it goes right down the throat of the substitute fielder Wanindu Hasaranga. Bangladesh are 4 down now for just 39 runs.
We are witnessing that Kusal Mendis has taken over the glovework.
Mahmudullah gets behind the line of the ball and defends it towards the off side.
Similar again, Mahmudullah tries to cut but misses again. He is living dangerously.
Kumara bowls this on a good length outside off, Mahmudullah tries to cut it but misses.
Short of a length ball outside off by Kumara, Mahmudullah cuts it towards deep backward point. Malinga cuts the ball off with his boot. 2 runs taken.
Lahiru Kumara into the attack now.
Rahim defends this ball presenting the full face of the bat towards cover.
Length ball just outside off, Rahim plays it towards point.
Length ball just outside off, Rahim guides it towards third man.
On the pads of Rahim by Thisara, the ball hits the pads as he misses the flick.
Full length ball just outside off, Mahmudullah plays it swiftly towards the point region. The fielder dives to his right and gets a hand to it. Single taken.
Good length ball, played off the front foot towards the cover fielder by Mahmudullah.
Powerplay 2 is on now. Only 4 fielders allowed outside the circle till the 40th over. Thisara Perera to bowl now.
Short of a length ball on off, Rahim blocks it out towards the off side.
Good length ball on the pads of Rahim, he clips it towards mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! First run after 15 dots! A short ball outside off, Rahim pulls it in front of mid-wicket and gets a boundary!
Around off, worked towards square leg.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Full and around off, flicked towards short mid-wicket.

Yorker by Malinga, on the off pole. Mahmudullah gets the bat down in time and jams it out. The ball flies almost behind the keeper but Kusal Perera leaps to his left and gets a glove to it. A wicket maiden here by Malinga.
Another great ball. Malinga is on song here. This one is fullish and on off pole. It just nips away from Mahmudullah, he is barely able to defend it.
Good length ball pitching on off pole and swinging away, Mahmudullah tries to defend it but plays inside the line. Goes past the outside edge.
Mahmudullah walks in at number 5, replacing Sarkar.

OUT! BOWLED! This time the yorker finds its mark and hits the leg stump! Malinga is on fire. Three yorkers in three balls and this time the ball fires past the bat. Soumya tries his best to get his bat down in time but misses. The ball goes under and hits the leg pole. Bangladesh are in a pool of trouble.
Excellent yorker, once again, this time it is dug out to the off side.
A yorker outside off, Sarkar looks to dig it out but misses.
On a length outside off, solidly defended.
Full and around off, solidly blocked out.
On a length outside off, coming in, watchfully defended.
Mushfiqur Rahim walks in at number 4, replacing Mithun.

OUT! LBW! Three reds and Mithun is out of here. The review has been wasted. Pradeep pitches it outside off and shapes back in, it hits the front pad of Mithun on the off pole line. He has shuffled across the stumps and leaves his leg stump exposed. Mithun thought that it was missing leg but the Ball Tracker shows it has dislodged the middle stump. Bangladesh have lost their second wicket and look in deep trouble here.

REVIEW TIME! Mithun has been adjudged LBW but he has taken the referral. Looks plumb. He was walking across the sticks while playing that shot and Ultra Edge does not detect any wood. Trouble. Big trouble. Ball Tracker shows the ball to be hitting the stumps. Poor referral.
Front foot defence to this full length ball outside off, he pushes it towards cover point.

Good length ball on off pole, Mithun punches it back towards Pradeep, he dives down to his left trying to get a hand on it. The ball crosses him and is stopped at mid off. Good length ball on off pole, Mithun punches back towards the bowler, he dives down to his left trying to get a hand on it. The ball crosses him and is stopped at mid off.
Bouncer again by Malinga but this time a controlled one. On middle stump line, Mithun pulls it uppishly towards deep fine leg and takes a single.
Wide! Too high for the umpire's liking. It is pitched on middle and off but goes way over the head of Mithun.
Good length ball outside off, Mithun defends it towards point.
Fuller ball this time outside off, Mithun plays it with strong hands towards the gap between point and cover point. The fielders cut it off and the batters take two runs.
BEATEN! Length ball just outside off, the ball moves away after pitching. Mithun tries to defend but plays inside the line of the delivery.
Down the leg side, flicked towards fine leg for a single. In fact, a leg bye has been signalled.
A full toss but swinging down the leg side, Sarkar misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Good length ball outside off, Sarkar plays it to the cover fielder but he fumbles. The batters take one run.
Length ball outside off, Mithun plays it towards third man for a single.

Just short of Malinga. It seems that he is everywhere in the match. Short ball this time by Pradeep, Sarkar hooks it but gets the top edge as the ball flies towards Malinga who is standing at deep fine leg. The batters cross and take a single.
Good length ball on the pads of Mithun. He flicks it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, pushed towards point.
On a length outside off, Mithun defends solidly.
Another yorker by Malinga but this time the quicker one. Sarkar is able to jam it out but just as the ball rolls to square leg.
Short delivery on the off pole this time by Malinga. Mithun goes onto the back foot and plays the pull shot. It goes uppishly towards the fine leg fielder but falls just short. The batters take one.
Malinga tries his signature slower yorker. It pitches on the middle pole but just short of the yorker length. Mithun is able to pick it up and he blocks it out.
Mithun defends this length ball off the back foot to cover point.
Wide! Slower full toss down the leg side. Mithun lets it go.

FOUR! Edged and over the slip fielder. This is a length ball wide outside off, Sarkar slashes hard at it but gets the outside edge. It flies over the fielder at third slip and into the fence for a boundary.
Slower delivery and a full toss outside off. Sarkar was completely bamboozled by the pace or lack of it. He almost chopped it onto the stumps. The ball goes to fine leg and the batters take a single.
Straighter in line, Sarkar flicks it over square leg. Malinga moves across to his right from fine leg and does well to eventually cut it off. The batsmen take three to close the 11-run over.
Outside off, Sarkar drives but finds mid off.
FOUR! Fine timing! An inviting delivery, on a length and outside off, Sarkar leans into his drive and thumps it through the gap at covers for a boundary.

This is the second time that Tamim Iqbal has been dismissed for a duck in his ODI career by Slinga. Overall, he becomes the third batsman to be dismissed twice for a duck in ODIs by Malinga. The other two are Virender Sehwag and Mohammad Hafeez.
Fullish and on off, defended off the front foot by Sarkar.
Good shot. There is width on offer outside off, Sarkar lifts it over the infield, wide of mid off and collects a couple of runs again.
Pitches it up and outside off, Sarkar drives it in the gap between extra cover and mid off for a couple of runs.
Another Malinga special here. The ball is pitched on yorker length, Mithun just about gets the bat down in time. The ball hits the bat and then the pad of Mithun.
Interesting. Both the sides lost their sole review on the first ball of the third over.
Malinga is getting some great movement here off the new ball. He pitches this one on middle and off, the ball pitches and moves away from Mithun. He edges it but fails well short of the slip fielder.
Good length ball on the pads of Sarkar, he tries to flick it but misses. It hits the pad of Sarkar and rolls down to fine leg. The batters cross for a single. Leg bye signalled.
Excellent follow-up delivery. A bouncer. Sarkar ducks underneath it.
A cracking yorker again, around off, Sarkar digs it out at the last moment.

NOT OUT! Sri Lanka lose their only review. Malinga was very sure but the replays have shown that it pitched outside leg. A near yorker that, landing around leg and pinging Sarkar first on his front boot and then deflects onto his bat. Malinga puts in an unsuccessful appeal and then convinces his skipper to take the DRS. Pitching outside leg and no need to look further.

What happened there? Lasith Malinga is very convinced that he has trapped Sarkar in front of the stumps. Big conference regarding that and Dimuth Karunaratne gets convinced to take the DRS. Pitching outside leg, shows the replay.
Good over by Pradeep. A dot to finish it. Length ball on off, he punches it towards point.
Mithun plays this length ball into the ground.
Length ball on off, played down the ground by Mithun.

Sarkar living dangerously here. This is again a length ball outside off, Sarkar tries to push it towards covers. The ball takes the inside edge of the bat and Sarkar almost chops it onto the stumps. The ball goes to fine leg and the batsmen take a single.
Play and a miss! Length ball just outside off, it nips just away from the angle. Sarkar goes for the drive down the ground but misses.
Good length ball outside off, Soumya plays it towards point.
Nuwan Pradeep to run in from the other end with the second new ball.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, shaping away, Mithun shoulders arms. What a first over by Malinga!
Mohammad Mithun is the number 3 batsman.

OUT! Malinga has done his magic again. What a ball! Corker of a yorker by Slinga-Malinga! Iqbal has maybe sunk into the occasion. Malinga releases the ball on the leg stump line, it swings in towards the pads of Iqbal, he tries to bring his bat down but the ball has gone through before that. It hits the pads of Tamim and crashes into the stumps as he falls onto the ground. The crowd has gone bonkers! Lasith is determined to make his last ODI truly memorable.
A high full toss on the off pole by Malinga. Iqbal blocks it out.
The typical Malinga yorker. He releases the ball outside off, it shapes back in towards the toe of Iqbal.
Wide! Down the leg side and Tamim lets it go.
Dead on middle stump this one on a good length. Tamim plays it down the ground.
Malinga starts with a full pace good length ball wide outside off. Tamim lets it go to the keeper. The crowd is bouncing.

Back for the run chase. The Lankan players give Lasith Malinga a guard of honour as he enters the field. A quick huddle after that and Slinga picks up the first new ball to open the bowling for his team one final time in this format. Tamim Iqbal and Soumya Sarkar are the Bangla openers. One slip in place. Here we go...
